name: wait-for
description: Agents finish the job even when they have to wait: a poller for external events (PR comments, access grants, deploys, data) plus a Stop hook that keeps the session alive until the wait is handled.

interface.shortDescription: Keep working while waiting on external events
interface.longDescription: A poller for review comments, access grants, deploys and data, plus a Stop hook that holds the session open until the wait is handled.
